title: Sessions store: use, shrink and archive thousands of sessions
description: Pair and chain duplicate sessions in time order, let sessions pull in references, reduce how many are saved (compaction has no --apply yet), archive old ones (Cloudflare copy waits on the R2 enable click), review the categorisation, skip re-auditing audited tasks, and decide what 'make use of the contents' means. 8 asks, several are research. Estimate about $12.
